locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the physical logarithmic interval is [-log(lambda),log(lambda)]
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(y)*exp(-i*t*y) dy and Plancherel measure is dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is included and translations at magnitude 2*log(lambda) vanish by zero extension
locked_conventions.inversion: multiplicatively Jf(u)=f(u^(-1)); in the additive logarithmic coordinate Jf(y)=f(-y)
locked_conventions.source_normalization: all prolate combinations use the source zero-Lebesgue-integral normalization, never unit normalization
locked_conventions.strictness: equality in a high margin, theta=1, rho=g, or a zero quotient-relative floor is a rejection
locked_conventions.finite_parity: Fourier residue class is not identified with inversion parity at finite lambda; (I+J)/2 and (I-J)/2 remain explicit
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: p and dps label exact rational theorem-regression models, not physical prolate-Weil pilot matrices or an asymptotic schedule
locked_conventions.arithmetic: all component matrices, selector weights, moments, contractions, and reserves are exact reduced rationals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden

locked_formulas.stop_loss_witness: for d>1 and sigma>0, eta=d*sigma/(2*sqrt(d-1)), g=m+(2-d)*sigma/(2*sqrt(d-1)), and V(g)<=eta
locked_formulas.source_metric: on X0=(ker A)^perp, Delta=(AA*)^dagger on K=ran(A) and <Ax,Delta Ax>=||x||^2
locked_formulas.positive_source: G_plus=g*A* A+(Q_X*X_K*A)*(Q_X*X_K*A), never g*I unless A is an isometry
locked_formulas.full_signed_contraction: if M_H^(-1)=L_plus-L_minus, G=g*A*A+(sqrt(L_plus)*F_K*A)*(sqrt(L_plus)*F_K*A), N=sqrt(L_minus)*F_K*A, then B>0 iff B_HH>0 and ||N*G^(-1/2)||^2<1
